title: IdentityUserRegisteredPayload
description: Payload of `identity.user.registered` version 1: a user was created, by the first successful one-time code for an identifier or by accepting an invitation. The envelope's `partner_id` is `null`, because a user is not scoped to a partner. The payload carries no email address or phone number. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know; new optional fields are an additive change.

channel.description: How the user registered: a one-time code by `email` or `phone`, or by accepting an `invitation`.
